paper.title_en: Thermalization of the Primordial Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background
paper.abstract_en: It is conventionally believed that the Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background (SGWB) from inflation provides information about the earliest universe. However, in this Letter, we present a different picture. Our analysis starts from the observation that the inflation-predicted spectrum implies gravitons reside in high-occupation states, which significantly enhances their self-interactions and triggers rapid thermalization. We show that approximately $80\%$ of the primordial gravitons participate in this thermalization, forming a Bose--Einstein distribution and thereby erasing the primordial information. Evaluated using typical inflation parameters, this thermalized spectrum yields a present-day peak frequency of $f_{0, \text{peak}}^{(\text{th})} \sim 1.4 \times 10^8 \, \mathrm{Hz}$ in the hundred-megahertz band with a peak amplitude of $Ω_{0, \text{peak}}^{(\text{th})} \sim 3.5 \times 10^{-13}$. Due to the sharp drop-off away from the peak, the resulting spectrum lies beyond the reach of low-frequency observatories like PTAs, LISA, and LIGO, but remains uniquely accessible to high-frequency detectors such as microwave cavity resonators and dielectric haloscopes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文质疑原初随机引力波背景可保留极早期宇宙信息的传统观点，提出高占据态下引力子自相互作用导致约80%原初引力子热化并抹除原初信息，给出热化谱峰值频率约1.4×10^8 Hz与峰值幅度约3.5×10^-13，并指出该谱超出PTA、LISA、LIGO等低频观测范围而可能由微波腔谐振器和介电晕探测器触及。论证涉及原初引力子自相互作用、热化与Bose-Einstein分布，理论深度较高；结果具体、可检验，表述清晰，对随机引力波背景研究方向具有潜在影响。
decision.title_zh: 原初随机引力波背景的热化
decision.abstract_zh: 传统上认为，来自暴胀的随机引力波背景（SGWB）提供了关于最早宇宙的信息。然而，在本快报中，我们呈现一幅不同的图景。我们的分析始于这样一个观察：暴胀预言的谱意味着引力子处于高占据态，这显著增强了它们的自相互作用并触发快速热化。我们表明，大约$80\%$的原初引力子参与这种热化，形成Bose--Einstein分布，从而抹除原初信息。使用典型暴胀参数评估，该热化谱给出今日峰值频率$f_{0, \text{peak}}^{(\text{th})} \sim 1.4 \times 10^8 \, \mathrm{Hz}$，位于百兆赫兹频段，峰值幅度为$Ω_{0, \text{peak}}^{(\text{th})} \sim 3.5 \times 10^{-13}$。由于远离峰值处急剧下降，所得谱超出PTA、LISA和LIGO等低频观测器的可及范围，但仍可被微波腔谐振器和介电晕探测器等高频探测器独特地触及。
